title: Registry adoption kit (how to implement the standard via FHIR/OMOP/REDCap)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Elyos never holds patient data. The adoption kit gives step-by-step guidance to implement the standard via each interoperability profile, referencing the consent/de-id requirements, to lower the barrier for a partner pilot (O1) (depends on fhir-040, omop-041, redcap-042, validator-051). Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Write a registry adoption kit covering implementation via each profile and referencing the consent/de-id requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Aimed at lowering the barrier for a partner pilot (O1)
